description: Groups and prioritizes Helm chart bumps for the add-ons upgradescope's registry tracks. STATIC: the chart names and the EOL list below were written by hand from registry/data (see examples/renovate/README.md); they do not follow your scan.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch bumps of tracked add-on charts land in one PR, labelled so the Dependency Dashboard and review queues can filter them.

A major bump of a tracked add-on chart is the one most likely to change its Kubernetes compatibility. Keep it out of the group, never merge it unattended, and let it wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.

Add-ons the registry lists as end of life. Bumping the chart keeps the release current but does not make a retired project supported, so these go first in the queue, say so in the PR, and are never merged unattended.
prBodyNotes: upgradescope's registry lists this add-on as end of life (for example ingress-nginx, archived 2026-03-24; the registry has the date for each). This bump does not make it supported: plan the migration to a maintained replacement (see the add-on's entry in registry/data, and for ingress-nginx https://kubernetes.io/blog/2026/01/29/ingress-nginx-statement/).
